releases.name: Missed Class: Horror
releases.summary:
You enter an abandoned school hoping to uncover the truth behind its mysterious closure. Empty classrooms, silent hallways, and forgotten lockers hide clues to what really happened.

But before you can leave, the doors lock behind you.

Now your only goal is to escape. Explore the school, collect keys and uncover the dark secrets hidden within its walls. Just don't ignore the feeling that you're being watched.

releases.name: Fallen City Brawl
releases.summary:
As a brutal battle for control of Fallen City's criminal underworld rages, four strangers join forces to survive and reclaim the streets! With a ferocious wolf at their sides, these unlikely allies will face impossible odds. Along the way, motivations and past lives will collide, further testing their loyalty as well as their fighting skills. Only by binding together can they reach the final showdown that will decide who lives and who falls.

Inspired by arcade beat 'em ups of the late '80s and early '90s, Fallen City Brawl is a story of ambition and revenge told through intense side-scrolling pixel art action.

releases.summary: Pilot your rocket-powered locomotive into battle against the drone armies. The subway tracks are the only way in and you are the city's last hope!? releases.name: EA Sports FC 27
releases.summary:
Step into The Grounds, a social football playground where the streets meet the stadium. From Kickabouts and 1v1s to teaming up with friends in Clubs, connect with renowned football mentors, improve your abilities, and express yourself on and off the pitch. Feel greater control in every game mode with more fluid, true-to-life gameplay, featuring dynamic corners, enhanced attacking awareness, player-focused defending tailored for competitive play, and more community-driven innovations. Sign your next star in Manager Career through a rebuilt Transfer Market with realistic player values and active club bidding. Master new negotiation tactics, including performance and buy-back clauses, as Dynamic OVRs reflect player form, morale, and fitness across every club. Immortalise your dream club in Football Ultimate Team™ with the brand-new FUT Gallery. Curate your favourite Player Items to grow your Gallery Level, earn rewards, and build your Club’s identity throughout the new football season.
Experience unrivalled authenticity in EA SPORTS FC™ 27, with match data from the world’s top leagues powering 21,000+ licensed players. [EA Sports]

releases.name: Sandwalkers
releases.summary:
Every decade, the Mka tribe sends caravans of adventurers into the Phithi, the meteorological chaos that keeps the Uwando tribes isolated from each other and makes life outside the refuges almost impossible.

Their mission: to establish diplomatic and trade relations, to explore and reclaim the lands left to the mercy of monsters and pirates, and, most importantly, to plant a new tree city that can become a refuge for the Mka and their allies. 

Sandwalkers is a roguelike turn-based exploration game. Build your team, traverse varied hostile environments, face countless dangers, and gain knowledge that will help you find and resurrect the Mother Tree Umama.

releases.name: Beautiful Girls on Campus: Memories of Youth
releases.summary:
Memorize a snapshot of school life in just one minute! Study every detail, then put your memory to the test. Can you recall what was there?

How much can you remember from a single moment on campus?

Take one minute to carefully study an image of beautiful girls enjoying everyday school life. Then, after part of the scene is hidden, choose the correct answer from four options.

What was there before?
What did that part of the scene look like?

You never know which detail the question will focus on, so pay attention to the characters, objects, and surroundings.

You may feel certain you remember something, only to hesitate when the choices appear. Follow your memory, spot the detail you saw before, and enjoy that satisfying moment when the answer comes back to you.

Take in the youthful campus atmosphere, remember every detail you can, and see how much of each scene stays in your memory!

releases.name: Phantom Thief Mirage and the Curious Clues
releases.summary:
Can you spot the clue?

A clue may be hiding in plain sight. Will you notice it before it slips away?

Even when you think you have seen everything, an unexpected detail may still be waiting to be found.

Phantom Thief Mirage and the Curious Clues is a one-question, one-answer picture puzzle game. Study a single illustration and choose the spot that answers the question.

The rules are simple!

・Read the question
・Examine every part of the illustration
・Choose the spot you think is the answer

That flash of insight when you find the right place feels great! Even a miss can lead to a new discovery when you take another careful look.

Take on the challenge alone, or share the fun with family and friends by asking, “Where do you think it is?”

releases.name: SiN: Reloaded
releases.summary:
From Nightdive Studios, SiN: Reloaded is a completely remastered experience of the 1998 shooter from Ritual Entertainment. This diamond-in-the-rough, story-driven FPS features memorable characters, horrific enemies, and a devastating arsenal that pushed the Quake II Engine to its limits.

Enter a near-future dystopian world as security consultant Colonel John R. Blade as you take on the seductively evil Doctor Elexis Sinclaire. When Elexis, the CEO of SinTEK Industries, begins injecting the streets with a DNA-altering drug, it's time to reassess the laws of morality. 

As Blade, you've made a religion out of fighting crime. Now you're going to make Elexis pay for her sins by taking on her unholy army of genetically-engineered mutants.

releases.name: Ghostly Whiskers
releases.summary:
Your beloved human has vanished into the night. As a pair of courageous cats, you’ll follow their scent to an abandoned mansion shrouded in fog and mystery. But this is no ordinary house — it’s alive with whispers, shadows, and secrets from the past.

Ghostly Whiskers is a short but unforgettable co-op (or solo) adventure that blends light horror with heartwarming moments. Solve puzzles, explore eerie rooms, and use your feline instincts — like squeezing through tight spaces, climbing ledges, and sniffing out hidden clues — to uncover the truth.

- Use your flashlight to reveal secrets in the dark
- Sniff out trails and memory fragments
- Explore a hand-crafted haunted mansion full of cozy, eerie charm
- Play solo or with a friend in split-screen co-op

releases.name: 16 Faces: School hp!
releases.summary:
How many types can you become?

Can you make it through school’s toughest moments without changing who you are?

We’ve all been there: being too serious for our own good, or wishing we had spoken up when it mattered.

This is a four-choice game where you change your personality to face one school crisis after another. Dive into a classmate’s mind through mental hacking and choose one of four options. Each choice shifts four personality gauges: introversion and extroversion, sensing and intuition, thinking and feeling, and judging and perceiving. Get three gauges into their target zones to successfully transform and solve the crisis with that personality type’s strengths.

Getting started is easy.
• Read the crisis
• Choose one of four options
• Watch the four gauges and aim for the target zones

Your survival level drops with every choice. If it reaches zero, you’re out. A successful transformation restores a large amount, and every type you awaken for the first time is recorded.

releases.name: PUPU's Adventure Park
releases.summary:
Run a fantasy theme park where heroes get to play adventurer!

Build all kinds of facilities, such as weapon shops, general stores, and tailor shops, then assign the right Pupus to run them. The harder the heroes “adventure” in your park, the more resources you earn, allowing you to keep expanding your very own adventure park.

As your park continues to grow, you’ll need more reliable workers. Breed new Pupus through the Spring of Life, build homes for them, and make cookies and cakes to keep them fed - yes, they absolutely love sweets! Of course, you’ll also need to take care of their little moods from time to time.

From basic shops to special NPCs like bards, merchants, and bounty hunters, keep unlocking blueprints to expand what your park can do. As construction goes on, you may even stumble upon the surprising story hidden behind this adventure park.

Post all kinds of tasks on the commission board to attract different types of heroes. Design your tasks wisely to maximize park revenue and obtain key resources such as rare items and hero essence, which can be used to upgrade and expand your park.
